info.title: Lupira Assistant API
info.description: The assistant hub/brain for Lupira: fire intake, agent runs, consent, and on-behalf-of writes. Authenticate with a Bearer token issued by Authentik.

get.summary: Authenticated claims echo for dependency probes; resolves nothing, writes nothing.

post.summary: Accept a due fire from lupira-cal-worker (accept-then-own).
Accept a closed topic from comms-api (accept-then-own).

get.summary: The caller's feed: pending approvals + open questions (default), or resolved history.

post.summary: Approve, edit, or dismiss a pending proposal. Idempotent on clientActionId.
Answer or skip an open question. Idempotent on clientActionId.
Mark a notice read. Idempotent on clientActionId.

get.summary: Whether the caller has a live offline grant (and for which audiences).
Get the caller's assistant profile (routing defaults).

put.summary: Set routing defaults (calendar/list/address-book) the assistant writes to.

get.summary: Get delivery preferences (per-item vs digest, quiet hours).

put.summary: Set delivery preferences. Quiet hours suppress the push only — items still land in the inbox.

post.summary: Register this device's Expo push token (idempotent on the token).

duplicate.description: True when this client action id was already processed (a replay).

ActionKind.description: A deterministic, no-LLM action executed directly at fire time.

answer.description: The answer text; null/empty with bool AnswerCheckInRequest.Skip unset is rejected.

skip.description: Dismiss the question without answering — no follow-up run is spawned.

AnswerCheckInRequest.description: Answer or skip an elicited question. Replay-safe on Guid AnswerCheckInRequest.ClientActionId.

status.description: The grant lifecycle state (`Active`/`Revoked`/`Expired`), null without a grant.

AuthStatusResponse.description: Whether the caller has a live offline grant (and for which downstream audiences).

BillDetail.description: A bill to pay. DateTimeOffset? TaskProposal.DueAt is the payment due date.

CalendarClass.description:
cal-api's calendar classification — relayed on the fire so Policy can tell agent
            scaffolding (System) from user records (Agenda). Mirrors LupiraCalApi.Domain.CalendarClass.

CalendarTarget.description:
Which calendar class the assistant suggests for a proposed event; the routing maps it to a
            concrete calendar id per principal.

ContactProposal.description: A proposed contact (lands in P's default address book).

DeliveryDetail.description: A parcel to receive. DateTimeOffset? TaskProposal.DueAt is the expected arrival.

DeliveryMode.description: Per-item = wake me for each item; digest = stay silent and let the digest carry them.

placeId.description:
The geo-api place the free-text string? EventProposal.Location resolved to (filled pre-consent by the
            place enricher). Sent to cal-api alongside string? EventProposal.Location; cal-api uses it when it can, else
            re-resolves the label itself.

EventProposal.description:
A proposed calendar event. CalendarTarget EventProposal.TargetCalendar is the agent's suggestion
            (Personal vs Group); the resolver maps it to a concrete calendar id.

FallbackMode.description: On a missed contract: retry once then ask (Retry), ask immediately (Ask), or drop (Drop).

FireAcceptedResponse.description:
The 202 body for an accepted fire/message: the recorded item id, and whether this was a
            dedupe hit (a redelivery that recorded nothing new).

principalId.description: The owning principal, stamped from calendar ownership and relayed by the worker.

calendarClass.description: System = agent scaffolding (free CRUD); Agenda = user record (consent-first).

dedupeKey.description: The cal-side `dedupe_key` (item_id + occurrence_at) — one run per occurrence across retries.

FireRequest.description:
The wire contract for `POST /fires` — a due fire pushed by lupira-cal-worker. Carries the
scheduled-fire context (item/calendar/occurrence/dedupe) plus the calendar classification Policy
needs and exactly one of ItemPrompt? FireRequest.Prompt / ItemAction? FireRequest.Action (XOR, validated server-side).
The cal doc leaves the body shape open; this mirrors the scheduled_fire columns +
the relayed principal_id and calendar class/kind.

topicRef.description: comms-api's stable topic id (also the ref for the open-topic tail pull).

releasedAt.description:
When comms released this window. Versions the dedupe key; absent (legacy sender) the
            key falls back to `Topic:{topicRef}` — one delivery per topic ever.

messages.description: The topic's messages in order (sender, timestamp, text).

InboundTopicRequest.description:
The wire contract for `POST /inbound` — a closed topic released by comms-api: a label plus an
ordered window of messages and comms-api's stable topic ref. Deduped on `Topic:{topicRef}:{releasedAt}`
so a reopened topic's re-release is a new inbound, while a retry of the same release stays idempotent.

id.description: The ApprovalRequest id (Proposal) or CheckIn id (Question) — what resolve/answer target.

title.description: The human line: the approval message / the frozen check-in question.

expiresAt.description: Questions may expire; an expired question is no longer answerable.

body.description: Notices carry their message body here; null for proposals and questions.

oneOf.description: Set when InboxItemKind InboxItemDto.Kind is InboxItemKind.Proposal.

InboxItemDto.description: One entry in the app's inbox feed, newest first.

nextCursor.description: Present when more history exists; pass back as `?cursor=`.

ItemAction.description:
A deterministic payload executed directly (no LLM). `ParamsJson` carries the frozen
            params (e.g. a SendCheckIn message + optional follow-up Prompt ref).

ItemPrompt.description: An LLM-interpreted, contracted payload → an agent run. Declared at authoring; enforced here at fire.

OutputKind.description: The ProposedAction kind a run is contracted to yield (assistant-api validates against it).

PingDto.description:
Claims echo for cross-service auth-seam probes; the audiences say which half of a
            broken seam is misconfigured.

quietHoursStart.description: ISO-8601 local time (`HH:mm`); null = no quiet hours.

timeZone.description: IANA zone the quiet-hours clock is read in; null = UTC.

PreferencesResponse.description: The caller's delivery preferences. Quiet hours are local wall-clock in string? PreferencesResponse.TimeZone.

PreferencesUpdateRequest.description:
Replace the delivery preferences. Absent `mode` keeps the current one; quiet hours are set as a
pair — sending either bound as null clears the window.

PromptFire.description:
Fire timing (flattened union): OnStart/OnEnd carry nothing; Offset uses `OffsetMinutes`
            (negative = lead time); AllDayAt uses `AllDayAt` (local wall-clock on the occurrence date).

PromptFireKind.description: When a payload fires relative to its item's occurrence.

PromptIntent.description: What an LLM-interpreted run should accomplish.

runId.description: The AgentRun that emitted this proposal (the audit trail behind it).

oneOf.description: For Update* kinds: the resolved record this proposal targets.

sources.description: Per-field provenance: payload field → the durable message refs that justify it.

ProposalDetailDto.description:
The proposal behind an approval card: what will be written on approve. Exactly one of the typed
payloads is set, matching ProposedActionKind ProposalDetailDto.ActionKind (event/contact/task/place families).

ProposalEdits.description: A user's edit of a proposal: exactly one slot is set, matching the proposal's kind.

ProposedActionKind.description:
What a ProposedAction would write. The agent run produces these; the M4 validator
checks the kind against the prompt's contracted `OutputKind`, and Policy (M5) routes the
write to free CRUD (agent scaffolding) or an ApprovalRequest (user records). The Writer (M6)
dispatches by kind to cal-api / tasks-api / career-api.

ReadNoticeRequest.description: Mark a notice read. Replay-safe on Guid ReadNoticeRequest.ClientActionId.

Ref.description: A reference the fired payload acts on. `Id` for Event/Contact/Task; `Url` for External.

deviceId.description: The app's device id, so a re-install supersedes its predecessor's token.

RegisterPushTokenRequest.description: Register this device's Expo push token. Idempotent on the token.

ReplyDetail.description:
A reply obligation: an unanswered message directed at the user, or the user's stated intent
            to contact someone. Routes to the "Replies" list with a recurring nudge. The assistant tracks that a
            reply is owed — it never drafts the reply text.

oneOf.description:
For ResolutionAction.Edit: the full edited payload in the slot matching the
            proposal's kind. Ignored for approve/dismiss.

clientActionId.description: Client-generated idempotency key (one per user gesture, stable across retries).

ResolveProposalRequest.description: Resolve a pending proposal. Replay-safe: the hub dedups on Guid ResolveProposalRequest.ClientActionId.

RoutingDto.description: The principal's resolved routing defaults (null = not yet learned/set).

RoutingUpdateRequest.description: Patch the routing defaults — only non-null fields are applied (others keep their value).

TaskProposal.description:
A proposed task. Lands on the "Assistant" list by default; a BillDetail? TaskProposal.Bill or
            DeliveryDetail? TaskProposal.Delivery instead routes it to the dedicated "Bills"/"Deliveries" list, carries its
            structured fields into the task's metadata, and (with DateTimeOffset? TaskProposal.DueAt) gets a linked cal-api
            reminder that fires at the due date / arrival. Bills and deliveries are tracked-to-done work, never
            calendar events.

TopicMessage.description:
One message inside a closed topic: who sent it, when, the text, comms-api's stable
            `SourceRef` (for provenance — the durable citation a proposal's field points back to), and whether
            the owner sent it (`FromPrincipal` — the inbound-vs-outbound signal for reply-obligation detection).
            Ordered within the topic. `Sender`/`SourceRef` are nullable — comms-api leaves sender null when
            the participant is unknown; grounding cites the message's window ordinal, so it holds even without a ref.

Bearer.description: OIDC bearer token. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
